Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Histone deacetylase 1 (CHEMBL325). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target CHEMBL325 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
